messages:
Marta (Finance): Heads-up 10pm ticket from Hygeia re: their renewal invoice RNL-2026-12. They say the platform banding applied the wrong annual multiplier during the renewal true-up, resulting in a $15,000 overcharge.

Evan (AM): Hygeia negotiated a stepped platform price in the SOW: first 1-3 clusters at $12k each, 4+ clusters at $9k. Renewal run applied the flat 12k multiplier to 5 clusters.

Pri (Billing Ops): Looking at the renewal engine logs 187420-ron1: the quantity break logic uses the catalog field "band_thresholds" but our migration to the new catalog left thresholds as strings in some rows, so the comparison failed and defaulted to highest band price. Patch candidate: billing/patch/handle-band-thresholds-1871.

Marta (Finance): Customer asking for immediate correction + refund for the overcharge ($15k). What's the recommended customer-facing approach?

Evan (AM): Sales wants a full refund for the overcharged amount and a reissued invoice. We should also confirm future renewals respect SOW banding.

Jordan (Legal): Contract SOW explicitly lists stepped pricing and effective renewal terms. Legal ok with refund + reissue. Include statement: "Refund issued to correct invoicing error; reissued invoice aligns with SOW."

Pri (Billing Ops): Proposed ops steps: 1) Void RNL-2026-12 and reissue RNL-2026-12A with corrected platform lines (5 clusters priced as 3*12k + 2*9k = $66k instead of $81k); 2) Issue credit memo CM-2026-315 for $15,000 and apply to the reissued invoice; 3) Merge patch and add unit test for string/number thresholds; 4) Create BF-2107 to scan active contracts for other catalog rows with string thresholds. ETA to reissue once approvals are in: 1 business day.

Marta (Finance): Approve steps. I'll draft the credit memo and route to Jordan for sign-off. Pri, please include internal memo code INTCORR-432 for FP&A tracking.

billing-bot: Created ticket TKT-9120 linking RNL-2026-12; branch billing/fix/band-thresholds-1871 created.

Evan (AM): I'll tell Hygeia we'll issue a refund and reissue the invoice ASAP. Please copy me on the customer email.

Pri (Billing Ops): Will do. Merging patch after CI; will post reissue confirmation here.

Marta (Finance): Thanks team. Will post once credit applied.

Evan (AM): Appreciate the quick fix. :thumbsup:
